name: All In One Custom Login Page Styler – Secure and Customize Your WordPress Login
author: Zia Imtiaz

sections.description:
All In One Custom Login Page Styler is a powerful WordPress plugin that allows you to fully customize and secure your login page (wp-admin). Whether you’re looking to personalize your login design, enhance security, or manage user login activity, this plugin has you covered.

This plugin combines advanced login page customization features with robust security tools, including the ability to hide or rename your login URL, integrate Google reCAPTCHA, limit login attempts, track login activity, and even restrict access based on IP or country. Additionally, you can create temporary login URLs for admin access, force logouts, and more.

With All In One Custom Login Page Styler, you get complete control over both the design and security of your WordPress login page.

Key Features

1. Login Customization

Easily modify your WordPress login page to align with your site’s branding. The plugin allows you to:
– Custom Logo: Replace the default WordPress logo with your own.
– Background Image/Color: Add custom backgrounds or choose solid colors.
– Form Styling: Customize the form width, border, padding, and color to match your design.
– Button Styling: Modify the login button color, hover effects, and border radius.

2. Security Features

Secure your login page with powerful tools:
– Google reCAPTCHA: Integrate Google reCAPTCHA to prevent automated bot logins.
– Limit Login Attempts: Restrict login attempts from a single IP to thwart brute-force attacks.
– IP and Region Blocking: Block login access from specific IP addresses or entire regions for extra protection.
– Force Logout: Admin can forcefully log out users to maintain security.

3. Temporary Login URLs

Generate temporary admin access URLs that expire after a set time (default 7 days). These can be used for secure, one-time logins, ideal for providing temporary access to users.

4. Login Logs and Activity Tracking

Track user login activity with detailed login logs. This includes:
– Last Login Time
– User IP Address
– User Role
– Location Tracking

You can also view failed login attempts and take necessary actions if suspicious activity is detected.

5. Login Redirection

Customize where users are redirected after login or logout. Redirect to any page or the default WordPress dashboard.

6. Custom Login URL

Change the default WordPress login URL (wp-login.php) to a custom URL for added security. This helps to hide your login page from unauthorized access.

7. Custom Login Menu

Add a custom login link to your site’s navigation menu for easy user access. You can also hide unnecessary menu items from the login page.

8. Hide WordPress Default Login Elements

  • Hide Login Logo: Remove the WordPress logo from the login page.
  • Hide Navigation Links: Remove “Back to Blog” and other unnecessary navigation links.
  • Hide Lost Password Link: Optionally remove the “Lost your password?” link for added security.

9. Passwordless Login

Enable passwordless login, allowing users to log in using a one-time password sent via email. Ideal for reducing login friction and improving security.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the Plugin: Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install directly via the WordPress admin panel.
  2. Activate the Plugin: Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure the Plugin: Go to “Settings” to configure plugin options, including login customization, security settings, and user activity tracking.
sections.faq:
How do I customize my login page?

To customize your login page, go to the Login Customization section in the plugin settings. Here, you can modify the logo, background, form fields, and button styles.

How do I enable Google reCAPTCHA?

In the Google reCAPTCHA settings, enter your Site Key and Secret Key. These keys can be obtained from the Google reCAPTCHA site.

How can I restrict access by IP or region?

Go to the IP and Region Blocking settings in the plugin and enter the IP addresses or regions you want to block from accessing the login page.

Can I track login attempts and activity?

Yes! The plugin logs user login activity, including IP address, time, location, and user role. You can view this information in the Login Logs section.

How do I generate temporary login URLs?

You can generate temporary login URLs from the Temporary Login URLs settings. These URLs expire after the specified time.

How do I redirect users after login?

Set up custom login redirections in the Login Redirection settings. Specify the URL users should be sent to after logging in or out.

Is there a way to limit login attempts?

Yes, in the Limit Login Attempts settings, you can define how many login attempts are allowed per IP before users are temporarily locked out.

How do I force log out users?

You can force log out users by using the Force Logout feature available in the login logs. Simply select the user and click “Force Logout.”

Version 7.1.1

  • Added Google reCAPTCHA integration for enhanced security.
  • Improved IP and Region blocking functionality.
  • Enhanced login log details, now including user role and location.
  • Added option to limit login attempts by IP address.

Version 6.2.6

  • Fixed Bugs and enhanced login form styling options.
  • Added Google Fonts for logos, buttons, and error messages.
  • Improved background image handling for mobile responsiveness.
